Heat a pan over medium heat and melt some butter. Pour batter and cook until bubbles form on surface. Flip and cook until golden. Serve with toppings.

Method: Boil pasta in salted water until al dente.
Sauté garlic in olive oil until fragrant. Toss pasta with garlic oil and parmesan. Serve immediately.
Classic Margherita Pizza Serves 1 large pizza
Method: Mix flour, yeast and salt. Add warm water and knead 10 minutes.
Let dough rise for 1 hour in a warm spot.
Preheat oven to 250°C with a pizza stone inside.
Shape dough into a 12-inch circle. Spread sauce, tear mozzarella on top. Bake 8-10 minutes until crust is golden. Top with fresh basil.
